subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Builds short words using sounds learnt; blends sounds to make words (c-at, m-at)

show.line: Let's show what we know! Blend the sounds, build the words. s, a, d. Sad!

rounds.prompt: Listen. n, a, p. What word is it?
Listen. d, i, p. Tap the word.
Change the m in mat to s. What word do you make?
Listen. m, a, p. What word is it?

hints: Say each sound, then push them together.
Look at the first letter. Start with its sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will read this word. n, a, p.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! n, a, p is nap. Pan starts with p.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's blend together. Nnn, a, p. Nap!

parent_line: Can blend and read short words with the sounds learnt this term.
